mapper.select: SELECT opportunity.stage, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id, COUNT(*) AS current_count, COALESCE(SUM(opportunity.expected_amount), 0) AS current_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN opportunity.status = 'OPEN' THEN opportunity.weighted_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weighted_forecast, SUM(CASE WHEN opportunity.status = 'OPEN' AND opportunity.stage_changed_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN opportunity.status = 'OPEN' AND opportunity.stage_changed_time IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, opportunity.stage_changed_time, #{asOf})) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS incomplete_seconds, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND history.opportunity_id = opportunity.opportunity_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS untracked_count FROM crm_opportunity opportunity JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = opportunity.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE opportunity.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity.deleted = 0 AND opportunity.owner_id = #{ownerId} GROUP BY opportunity.stage, customer.dept_id, customer.owner_id

SELECT history.from_stage AS stage, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(history.duration_seconds), 0) AS completed_seconds FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history history JOIN crm_opportunity opportunity ON opportunity.opportunity_id = history.opportunity_id AND opportunity.tenant_id = history.tenant_id AND opportunity.deleted = 0 JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = opportunity.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE history.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND history.from_stage IS NOT NULL AND history.entered_time >= #{start} AND history.entered_time < #{end} AND history.changed_time <= #{asOf} AND opportunity.owner_id = #{ownerId} GROUP BY history.from_stage, customer.dept_id, customer.owner_id

SELECT entry.to_stage AS stage, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id, COUNT(DISTINCT entry.opportunity_id) AS cohort_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history exit_event WHERE exit_event.tenant_id = entry.tenant_id AND exit_event.opportunity_id = entry.opportunity_id AND exit_event.history_id > entry.history_id AND exit_event.from_stage = entry.to_stage AND exit_event.changed_time <= #{asOf} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(exit_event.snapshot, '$.direction')) IN ('FORWARD', 'WON')) THEN entry.opportunity_id END) AS converted_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history won_event WHERE won_event.tenant_id = entry.tenant_id AND won_event.opportunity_id = entry.opportunity_id AND won_event.history_id >= entry.history_id AND won_event.to_stage = 'WON' AND won_event.changed_time <= #{asOf} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history restored WHERE restored.tenant_id = won_event.tenant_id AND restored.opportunity_id = won_event.opportunity_id AND restored.history_id > won_event.history_id AND restored.from_stage = 'WON' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(restored.snapshot, '$.direction')) = 'REOPEN' AND restored.changed_time <= #{asOf})) THEN entry.opportunity_id END) AS won_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history lost_event WHERE lost_event.tenant_id = entry.tenant_id AND lost_event.opportunity_id = entry.opportunity_id AND lost_event.history_id >= entry.history_id AND lost_event.to_stage = 'LOST' AND lost_event.changed_time <= #{asOf} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history restored WHERE restored.tenant_id = lost_event.tenant_id AND restored.opportunity_id = lost_event.opportunity_id AND restored.history_id > lost_event.history_id AND restored.from_stage = 'LOST' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(restored.snapshot, '$.direction')) = 'REOPEN' AND restored.changed_time <= #{asOf})) THEN entry.opportunity_id END) AS lost_count FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history entry JOIN crm_opportunity opportunity ON opportunity.opportunity_id = entry.opportunity_id AND opportunity.tenant_id = entry.tenant_id AND opportunity.deleted = 0 JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = opportunity.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE entry.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND entry.changed_time >= #{start} AND entry.changed_time < #{end} AND entry.changed_time <= #{asOf} AND opportunity.owner_id = #{ownerId} GROUP BY entry.to_stage, customer.dept_id, customer.owner_id
